notes.title: Update (Ver.1.0.1) Notice [2024/04/18]
notes.notes:
We have released the following content update (Ver:1.0.1).
- We have changed the specifications for character voice playback so that the voice will be played even if purchased or accessed from a region other than Asia.
- Minor bug fixes and UI and text adjustments


*The language of this game is not yet supported in English. 
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to players living in English-speaking countries.
